The '''Valtaullu Rift''' was a location deep within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] that [[Cronal]] had traveled to.<ref name="LSatSoM" /> The [[Kanzer Exiles]] were originally from this area<ref name="BoSSftDS" /> and built the world-sized [[Temple of Korman Lao]] near<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref> the Rift.
